source_notice: Metrics audited from propose_9 saved arrays. CSV files distribute only original YAeHMOP EHT predictions; no external PBE reference curves. Values cannot be pooled across C2DB and independent PySCF reference sources.

graphene_c2db.target: External C2DB PBE/no SOC, same 400-point original curve interpolated on 361 EHT nodes; trained on 37 nodes; NOT 361 independent DFT.
graphene_c2db.best_model: Native true carbon 2p double-zeta p-DZ7, 7 active variables; requires optional patched YAeHMOP, not stock.

graphene_pyscf.target: Independent PySCF/GTH-SZV PBE; different reference from external C2DB.

family_pyscf.reference: PySCF/GTH-SZV PBE for 2D carbon. Phagraphene SCF Gamma-only, 9 sampled path nodes; not Dirac or gap converged.
family_pyscf.nested_pdz7_note: Numerically smallest heldout error but near-zero second 2p radial coefficient, not evidence that double-zeta improves transfer.
family_pyscf.recommended_model: Simpler frozen shared sp5 (0.15644 eV held-out)

disclaimer: Training performance is not transfer. Comparisons are only within the same reference dataset and benchmark definition.
